basis: The first ten InsightBench answers were inspected during AI-assisted development.
Flags 11 and 12 were used for source-valid debugging and may guide implementation retention.
Flags 13-30 are reserved before any score-guided development on them.
InsightEval is target-test only and may not update prompts, skills, budgets, or code.

rules.source-train: May be consumed by the extraction agent and contain inspected answers.
rules.source-valid: May select or reject candidates; cannot be promoted to source-test.
rules.source-test: May be evaluated only after the package and protocol are frozen; cannot guide changes.
rules.target-test: May be evaluated only after source-test; must never update skills, prompts, budgets, or code.
